title: Null homotopy for the module-valued ordered kernel
statement: Let $X',T'$ be schemes, $f':X'\to T'$ a morphism, $M$ an $\mathcal O_{X'}$-module sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and $W_i$ any finite family of opens indexed by $\operatorname{Fin}(r)$. Let $D$ be a nonnegative cochain complex of module sheaves. Assume natural isomorphisms $e_p$ from its underlying presheaves of global-ring modules to the usual all-tuple Cech terms, commuting with the differentials. Assume on every open $C\subset X'$ that the $y$-coordinate sends $b s$ to $b|_{(\bigcap_lW_{y(l)})\cap C}$ times that coordinate, for all local scalars $b\in\Gamma(C,\mathcal O_{X'})$. Set $L=(f'_*D)^{\mathrm{ext}}$ and use its ordered coordinate maps $q$ [def-pc-ordered-cech-module-coordinates]. If a cochain endomorphism $g:L\to L$ satisfies $q_{p,B,t}(g(s))=0$ for all nonnegative degrees $p$, opens $B\subset T'$, sections $s\in\Gamma(B,L^p)$, and increasing tuples $t$, then $g$ is null homotopic as a module-sheaf cochain map. No ordered complex, cover, augmentation, affineness, or nonempty family is assumed.

source.place: Tag 01FM, equations 20.23.6.1 and 20.23.6.2; Coherence part (a), the usual Cech composite is homotopic to identity; comparison proof steps 3 and 4

proof.text: Obtain the cochain endomorphism P characterized by the finite signed full-coordinate formula, and a homotopy from identity to P. The formula uniquely specifies P, so no arbitrary geometric data is selected.

For each nonnegative degree, open and section g(s), each increasing permutation summand in the full-coordinate formula is zero by hg, while the other summands are zero by their filters. Hence every full coordinate of P(g(s)) vanishes. Evaluated product projections are jointly injective by the preserved limit; cancel e and extendXIso to get P(g(s))=0. Negative-degree terms are zero by extension. Morphism extensionality gives g composed with P equals zero.
Precompose the homotopy identity~P by g, and rewrite g composed with identity as g and g composed with P as zero. This yields the requested null homotopy.

proof_origin.note: Compiled kernel argument from the two separate assembly lemmas; joint injectivity, permutation-sum vanishing and homotopy composition proved in Lean.

theorem orderedCech_module_kernel_nullHomotopic {X' T' : Scheme.{u}} (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    (M : X'.Modules) {r : ℕ} (W₀ : ULift.{u} (Fin r) → X'.Opens)
    (D : CochainComplex X'.Modules ℕ)
    (e : ∀ p : ℕ, (PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).obj
          (D.X p).val ≅
        ((cechComplexFunctor W₀).obj
          ((prod.functor (C := X'.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
            (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj
              M.presheafModuleCat)).X p)
    (hd : ∀ p : ℕ,
        (PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).map
            (D.d p (p + 1)).val ≫ (e (p + 1)).hom =
          (e p).hom ≫ ((cechComplexFunctor W₀).obj
            ((prod.functor (C := X'.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
              (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj
              M.presheafModuleCat)).d p (p + 1))
    (hlinear : ∀ (p : ℕ) (y : Fin (p + 1) → ULift.{u} (Fin r)) (B : X'.Opens),
        let c : Γ(D.X p, B) → Γ(M, (∏ᶜ fun l ↦ W₀ (y l)) ⨯ B) :=
          fun s ↦ ((e p).hom ≫ Pi.π (fun y : Fin (p + 1) → ULift.{u} (Fin r) ↦
            ((prod.functor (C := X'.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
              (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj
                M.presheafModuleCat).obj
                (op (∏ᶜ fun l ↦ W₀ (y l)))) y).app (op B) s
        ∀ (a : Γ(X', B)) (s : Γ(D.X p, B)),
          c (a • s) = X'.presheaf.map (prod.snd :
            (∏ᶜ fun l ↦ W₀ (y l)) ⨯ B ⟶ B).op a • c s)
    (g : ((((Modules.pushforward f').mapHomologicalComplex _).obj D).extend
      ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)
        ⟶ ((((Modules.pushforward f').mapHomologicalComplex _).obj D).extend
      ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat))
    (hg : ∀ (p : ℕ) (B : T'.Opens) (s : Γ(
        ((((Modules.pushforward f').mapHomologicalComplex _).obj D).extend
      ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat).X (p : ℤ), B))
      (t : Fin (p + 1) ↪o Fin r),
      orderedCechModuleCoordinate f' M W₀ D e p B t ((g.f (p : ℤ)).app B s) = 0) :
    Nonempty (Homotopy g 0)
